name: clipboard
description: Adds a copy button to all <pre><code> blocks. Button uses GitHub Octicons SVGs (no external dependency). Shows checkmark for 2s after copy. Activated by params.clipboard = true.

params.description: Enable code block copy buttons on all <pre><code> elements site-wide.
params.effect: Loads caps/clipboard/clipboard.css and caps/clipboard/clipboard.js. Adds copy button to every code block.

css.note: Override --mdf-clipboard-* CSS variables in sub-theme main.css to match brand colors

js.note: No external dependencies. Pure vanilla JS.

locked.reason: clipboard.js scans for .clipboard-button class to prevent duplicate buttons. Renaming breaks the guard.

partials.note: Sub-theme injects clipboard.css + clipboard.js here when params.clipboard = true
